decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical IOCTL codes and packet structures.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
BIOS, DOS and COMMAND modules include ioctl.inc.
BIOS MSDIOCTL emits a table using GET_DEVICE_PARAMETERS, SET_DEVICE_PARAMETERS, GET_MEDIA_ID, SET_MEDIA_ID and SENSE_MEDIA_TYPE.
All 1733 bytes of the previously compared MSDIOCTL contribution match target IO.SYS (review 011).
The prior DOS IOCTL comparison covered 735 bytes, with all 22 differences in marked relocation fields (review 073).
limitations: Selected module comparisons support codes and structures exercised there; not every packet, optional configuration or final link address is proven. Complete core binary identity remains unverified.
